anthropic-503-credential-validation-text.source: the 2026-11-13 outage: 47 Opus calls in 15 trials got HTTP 503 with no usage, 09:47 to 13:32 UTC. The proxy log keeps no bodies; Claude Code showed 'API Error: 503 credential validation failed' in 9 trials, which is how the Anthropic SDK renders a plain-text 503 body or a JSON body with a top-level message (next fixture); Anthropic's error envelope renders as the raw JSON instead.

anthropic-503-credential-validation-mess.source: the same outage message as a top-level JSON message, the other body the Anthropic SDK prints as 'API Error: 503 credential validation failed'

anthropic-503-credential-validation-enve.source: the same outage message in Anthropic's error envelope (https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/errors, Error shapes), in case the edge answered in JSON

anthropic-503-empty.source: the 2026-11-13 outage: 47 Opus calls in 15 trials got HTTP 503 with no usage, 09:47 to 13:32 UTC. The proxy log keeps no bodies; Claude Code showed '503 status code (no body)' in 3 trials, which is how the Anthropic SDK renders a 503 with an empty body.
